name: Stumble
body:
School transmutation; Level precog 0, witch 0, witchwarper 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You momentarily transpose the position of the limbs the target is using to move or interfere with its proprioception. If the target fails its Reflex save, it can move at only half speed for 1 round. A flying creature also descends 10 feet.
